Wrote [design candidate](/tmp/exposed-constant-design-astra.md).

Recommend `ReviewedFamily` enum with derived `strum::EnumIter` and exhaustive key/name/spelling methods. This removes JSON decoding and numeric family indices without introducing a second registry. Preserve lexical conflict-key ordering explicitly.

Keep existing grouping behavior tests; replace serialization tests with constant coherence and reviewed-spelling coverage. Constants still occupy binary space; savings come from removing JSON/schema bytes and runtime parsing.
